'''Mumuu-fighting''' was a spectator sport popular on the [[planet]] [[Kalee/Legends|Kalee]]. It involved [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] matadors equipped with [[lig sword]]s battling [[Mumuu/Legends|mumuus]].<ref name="Lord of War">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/86/indexp2.html|text=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War|int=The Story of General Grievous: Lord of War}}</ref>

Mumuu-fighting is comparable to modern day [[Wikipedia:bullfighting|bullfighting]].
